_comment: Real MCP servers (streamable-HTTP transport). job-sources exposes search_{provider}_jobs and get_{provider}_job tools per provider (currently indeed, stepstone, linkedin) — used by scan-jobs, prepare-apply, cover-letter. cv-renderer (JsonToCvApi) exposes ping and render_cv(cv) which renders a CV JSON to PDF and returns an expiring download URL — used by prepare-apply.
